items.rationale: Gară, Aeroport and Stație name transport stopping facilities in the displayed ordinary senses; Vapor is a vehicle. The label does not claim that every station is a railway terminus. All are common travel vocabulary, with no obscure or regional identity needed. Independent agent factual/recognition judgment; not a measured human enjoyment result.

A mânca and A bea consume food or liquid; A găti prepares food; A citi reads text. The explicit preparation-or-consumption predicate covers the three food verbs honestly. Reading a recipe is an incidental situation, not the lexical meaning of reading. Drinking has its neutral liquid sense; no alcohol claim is embedded. Independent agent factual/recognition judgment; not a measured human enjoyment result.

Vânt, Nor and Ceață describe atmospheric conditions, whereas Noapte is a time interval. The weather members need no specialist taxonomy to distinguish from night. Ordinary science vocabulary and dictionary senses support recognition. Independent agent factual/recognition judgment; not a measured human enjoyment result.

Banană, Portocală and Lămâie are edible fruits; Morcov names the familiar edible root. The predicate avoids falsely treating banana as citrus or equating all fruit with sweetness. Common grocery vocabulary, with no specialist botanical exception required. Independent agent factual/recognition judgment; not a measured human enjoyment result.

Stafide are dried grape berries. Lopată is a tool for moving earth, as the tightened label says. Trotuar is the pedestrian part of a public road. Gât supports Cap. These four explicit everyday relationships are factual; no metaphorical sense or regional association is necessary. Independent agent factual/recognition judgment; not a measured human enjoyment result.

A biscuit can shed a firimitură; a taburet is a seat without a back; weekend is the end-of-week interval; soup is commonly served in a castron. None of the labels claims exclusivity outside this board. Exact standard dictionary senses distinguish the intended pairs. Independent agent factual/recognition judgment; not a measured human enjoyment result.

Night is a usual time for sleeping, not the only possible time. Frigider and Congelator both keep food cold at different temperatures. Buză is the fleshy edge of Gură; a scamă is a detached textile fibre. These are ordinary concrete senses; no misleading identity or absolute timing claim remains. Independent agent factual/recognition judgment; not a measured human enjoyment result.

Gardena documents leaf gathering with the garden rake; a vacuum cleans a carpet; a mother is a parent and a baby is an early-life child. WWF confirms forest habitat for Romanian wolves; the label says one habitat, not an exclusive habitat. The four claims are familiar and factual without hidden species trivia. Independent agent factual/recognition judgment; not a measured human enjoyment result.
